responsibility: Declares the `Lexer` class and its public tokenization interface for the D front end. It exposes source-buffer position tracking, current-token state, token scanning and lookahead routines, literal-parsing helpers, UTF decoding, doc-comment collection, and location/error reporting services used by the parser and other code that needs direct lexical access.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of `lexer`; unlike `lexer.c`, which performs the actual scanning, it defines the `Lexer` class state and publishes the tokenization, lookahead, string/number literal, UTF, and comment-handling interfaces used by the parser.
